name: print-social-dark-neon-ui-kit-anatomy-poster-with-side-labels
title: Dark Neon UI Kit Anatomy Poster
whatItIs: A tall dark poster with a large gradient headline, a subheading and a single framed UI-kit panel showing colour, typography, buttons, inputs, cards, icons and states, with five pill labels on the left connected by dotted lines to each section.
whatItMeans: Connecting pill labels to sections turns a component sheet into a clear map, and glowing cyan and violet feel modern and technical.
techniques: Pill labels at the left linked by dotted lines to sections
Gradient headline in cyan to white
One framed sheet containing every component group
Footer line summarising the system's promise

vocabulary.definition: A poster labelling the parts of a system or object.
A label connected by a line to a part of an image.
A board showing all elements of a UI kit together.
